game_concept: A tower defense set in Coastal Port – Cliffside Fort, a fort on the sea cliffs: the fisher must handle rogue waves while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Weather Switch: Choose tools by checking weather and terrain conditions each turn.
theme: Coastal Port – Cliffside Fort: a fort on the sea cliffs
core_gameplay_loop: In Cliffside Fort, repeat each round: Choose tools by checking weather and terrain conditions each turn. Each round, rogue waves strike the sea wall, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the gear_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the sea wall from rogue waves in Cliffside Fort: keep the gear_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 31-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: gear_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 31-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 4 (applied tier): Weather Switch
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Weather Switch' (Week 3 slot 7), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Cliffside Fort'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gear_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue waves in Cliffside Fort.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 31 seconds while gear_ok > 0.
